enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night with the fan running for air circulation
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Close eyes. Turn head to the side. Remain lying in the bed. Shift body position from back to side. Pull the blanket up. Remain lying through the night. Fan runs continuously in the room.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, showering with hot water from the water heater and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the bathroom light. Sit on the toilet. Stand up. Flush the toilet. Walk to the shower. Turn on the water heater switch. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the water temperature. Step under the water. Wet the hair. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Pour shampoo into the hand. Rub shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub soap over the body. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Rub the towel over the hair. Wipe the body with the towel. Hang the towel on the rack. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Turn off the tap. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle for tea, toasting bread and eating a relaxed holiday breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the bread and butter. Close the refrigerator door. Take two slices of bread out of the bag. Place the slices into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Open the cupboard. Take out a plate. Place the plate on the counter. Take out a cup from the cupboard. Place the cup on the counter. Open the drawer. Take out a knife. Place the knife on the counter. Take out a tea bag and drop it into the cup. Kettle switches off. Pick up the kettle. Pour hot water into the cup. Put the kettle down. Toaster pops up. Pick up the toasted slices. Place them on the plate. Pick up the knife. Spread butter on the toast. Put the knife down. Carry the plate and cup to the kitchen table. Sit on the chair. Pick up a slice of toast. Bite into the toast. Chew. Pick up the cup. Sip the tea. Put the cup down. Continue eating the toast. Finish the toast. Drink the remaining tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher and wiping down the counters
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Pick up the plate. Carry the plate to the sink. Pick up the cup. Carry the cup to the sink. Rinse the plate under the tap. Rinse the cup under the tap. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the lower rack. Place the plate into the rack. Place the cup into the rack. Push the rack back in. Close the dishwasher door. Press the dishwasher start button. Pick up a cloth. Turn on the tap. Wet the cloth. Wipe the table surface with the cloth. Wipe the counter with the cloth. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Wring the cloth out. Hang the cloth on the hook. Turn off the tap. Wipe hands with a hand towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting on the sofa with a cup of tea, watching TV and scrolling news on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Pick up the remote control from the table. Press the TV power button. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the phone from the table. Press the phone power button. Swipe the screen. Open the news app. Scroll the news list with the finger. Tap a news article. Read the article on the screen. Swipe back to the list. Scroll further. Put the phone down on the sofa cushion. Pick up the cup of tea. Sip the tea. Place the cup back on the table. Pick up the remote control. Press the channel button. Watch the TV screen. Press the volume button. Put the remote control down. Pick up the phone again. Swipe the screen. Continue scrolling the news. Put the phone down.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming the living room floor and tidying up the shared space
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the sofa. Walk to the storage corner. Bend down. Pick up the vacuum cleaner. Unwind the power cord. Plug the cord into the wall socket. Press the vacuum power button. Push the vacuum cleaner across the floor. Pull it back. Move toward the sofa area. Push the vacuum under the sofa edge. Pull it out. Move toward the TV stand. Vacuum around the stand. Move toward the corner. Vacuum along the wall edge. Press the vacuum power button to stop it. Pull the plug out of the socket. Wind the cord around the hook. Pick up the vacuum cleaner. Put it back in the storage corner. Bend down. Pick up the cushions on the floor. Place the cushions on the sofa. Pick up the remote control. Place it on the table. Pick up the cup. Carry it to the kitchen. Return to the living room. Straighten the sofa cover with both hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the local shops to buy groceries and household supplies for the week
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the entrance. Put on shoes. Pick up the shopping bag. Open the front door. Step outside. Close the door. Walk along the street. Walk to the crossing. Wait at the crossing. Cross the road. Continue walking along the pavement. Reach the shop entrance. Push the shop door open. Walk inside. Pick up a shopping basket. Walk to the vegetable section. Pick up vegetables. Place them in the basket. Walk to the fruit section. Pick up fruit. Place them in the basket. Walk to the dairy section. Open the refrigerator door. Pick up milk. Close the refrigerator door. Place the milk in the basket. Walk to the dry goods aisle. Pick up pasta. Place it in the basket. Pick up cleaning supplies. Place them in the basket. Walk to the checkout. Place the basket on the counter. Take out items one by one. Place them on the belt. Pay with the card. Tap the card on the reader. Put the card back into the pocket. Place the items into the shopping bag. Pick up the bag. Walk out of the shop. Walk back along the street. Cross the road. Walk to the building entrance. Open the door. Walk up to the flat. Open the door. Step inside. Close the door. Take off shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking groceries into the refrigerator and preparing a simple lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Carry the shopping bag into the kitchen. Place the bag on the counter. Open the refrigerator door. Take the milk out of the bag. Place the milk on the refrigerator shelf. Take vegetables out of the bag. Place them in the vegetable drawer. Take the fruit out. Place it in the drawer. Take the pasta out. Place it in the cupboard. Take the cleaning supplies out. Place them under the sink. Fold the empty bag. Put the bag away. Close the refrigerator door. Open the cupboard door. Take out a bowl. Place the bowl on the counter. Open the refrigerator. Take out lettuce and tomatoes. Close the refrigerator. Place them on the cutting board. Pick up a knife. Cut the tomatoes. Cut the lettuce. Place the cut pieces into the bowl. Open the refrigerator. Take out cheese. Close the refrigerator. Cut the cheese. Add it to the bowl. Pick up a fork. Stir the salad.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch at the kitchen table
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the bowl. Carry it to the kitchen table. Place the bowl on the table. Pull out the chair. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork. Stab a piece of lettuce. Lift the fork to the mouth. Chew. Put the fork down. Pick up the glass of water. Sip. Put the glass down. Pick up the fork again. Eat another mouthful. Chew. Continue eating until the bowl is empty. Put the fork down in the bowl. Pick up the glass. Drink the remaining water. Stand up. Pick up the bowl and fork. Carry them to the sink. Place them in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting on the bed with the fan on, listening to a podcast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Press the fan switch. Sit on the edge of the bed. Lie down on the bed. Pull the pillow under the head. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Press the phone power button. Unlock the screen. Open the podcast app. Tap a podcast episode. Place the phone on the bedside table. Close eyes. Turn the head to the side. Shift the body position. Remain lying on the bed. Turn onto the other side. Pull the blanket over the legs. Remain lying. Open eyes. Pick up the phone. Tap the pause button. Put the phone down.

enriched_activities.activity: Strolling through the park and dropping in at the community centre to check the noticeboard
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on the bed. Stand up. Walk to the entrance. Put on shoes. Pick up the keys. Open the front door. Step outside. Close the door. Walk down the stairs. Walk out of the building. Walk along the pavement. Enter the park gate. Walk along the park path. Pass the bench. Walk around the pond. Continue along the path. Walk out of the park. Walk along the street. Reach the community centre. Push the door open. Step inside. Walk up to the noticeboard. Stand in front of the noticeboard. Read the notices. Raise the phone. Take a photo of a notice. Lower the phone. Turn around. Walk to the door. Push the door open. Step outside. Walk back along the street. Walk to the building. Walk up the stairs. Open the door. Step inside. Close the door. Take off shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Playing a video game on the game console
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Pick up the controller from the shelf. Press the console power button. Press the controller power button. Sit down on the sofa. Press the TV power button with the remote control. Press the input button. Wait for the console menu. Press the direction button. Select the game icon. Press the confirm button. Hold the controller with both hands. Press the buttons to move the character. Press the jump button. Press the attack button. Tilt the controller. Continue pressing the buttons. Reach the game level end. Press the pause button. Press the menu button. Press the save option. Exit to the main menu. Press the console power button. Put the controller down on the shelf. Press the TV power button. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Freshening up with a quick wash and changing into comfortable clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Wet the hands. Pick up the soap. Rub soap on the hands. Rub hands together. Rinse hands under the tap. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Wipe the neck. Hang the towel on the rack. Walk to the bedroom. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a T-shirt. Take out trousers. Close the wardrobe door. Take off the shirt. Take off the trousers. Put on the T-shirt. Put on the trousers. Smooth the clothes with both hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and oven, with the range hood on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Press the range hood button. Open the refrigerator door. Take out chicken and vegetables. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables on the cutting board. Cut the chicken. Place the pieces into a bowl. Press the induction cooker power button. Place a pan on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Pick up the spatula. Add the chicken to the pan. Stir with the spatula. Add the vegetables. Stir again. Sprinkle salt. Stir the food. Press the oven power button. Open the oven door. Place a tray with potatoes into the oven. Close the oven door. Set the timer. Turn the chicken with the spatula. Press the induction cooker off button. Pick up a plate. Spoon the food onto the plate. Open the oven door. Take out the tray. Close the oven door. Press the oven off button. Press the range hood off button.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and chatting on the phone afterwards
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the plate. Carry it to the kitchen table. Place the plate on the table. Pull out the chair. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork. Take a piece of chicken. Lift the fork to the mouth. Chew. Pick up the glass. Sip water. Put the glass down. Pick up the fork again. Eat the vegetables. Continue eating until the plate is empty. Put the fork down. Stand up. Pick up the plate. Carry it to the sink. Pick up the phone. Press the phone power button. Tap the phone app. Tap a contact name. Raise the phone to the ear. Talk about the day. Listen. Laugh. Say goodbye. Tap the end call button. Put the phone down on the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa after the meal
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Pick up the remote control. Press the TV power button. Sit down on the sofa. Lean back against the cushion. Press the channel button. Watch the TV screen. Press the volume button. Put the remote control on the armrest. Cross the legs on the sofa. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Unlock the screen. Swipe the screen. Open a social media app. Scroll the feed. Tap a video. Watch the video. Close the app. Put the phone down on the table. Pick up the remote control. Change the channel. Watch the TV screen. Press the TV power button. Stand up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on the computer under the desk lamp, drafting next week's community program schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Press the desk lamp switch. Open the laptop lid. Press the computer power button. Wait for the screen to load. Move the mouse. Click the calendar icon. Open the schedule document. Place both hands on the keyboard. Type the text. Move the mouse. Click the cell. Type the times. Move the hand to the mouse. Scroll down the page. Type more entries. Press the backspace key. Retype the text. Pick up the phone. Unlock the screen. Check the calendar app. Put the phone down. Continue typing. Move the mouse. Click the save button. Click the close button. Press the computer power button. Close the laptop lid. Press the desk lamp switch. Stand up from the chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash, brushing teeth and skincare routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Wet the face with water. Pick up the face wash. Squeeze the face wash onto the hand. Rub the hands together. Rub the face with both hands. Rinse the face under the tap. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Pat the face dry with the towel. Hang the towel on the rack. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Put the toothbrush back into the holder. Open the cabinet. Take out the moisturizer. Squeeze the cream onto the fingers. Apply the cream to the face. Close the cabinet. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading on the phone and setting out clothes for tomorrow
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Sit on the edge of the bed. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Unlock the screen. Open the reading app. Scroll the page. Read the text. Swipe to the next page. Continue reading. Tap the screen. Scroll down. Close the app. Put the phone down. Stand up. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt. Place it on the chair. Take out trousers. Place them on the chair. Take out socks. Place them on the chair. Close the wardrobe door. Walk to the bed. Sit down on the edge of the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Dimming the lights and going to sleep with the fan on low
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up. Walk to the light switch. Press the light switch to dim the main light. Walk to the fan. Press the fan button to the low setting. Walk to the bed. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Place the head on the pillow. Turn onto the side. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed. Shift the legs. Pull the blanket up. Turn onto the back. Remain lying through the night. Fan runs on low.
